newsitem.title: USA: Starwood acquires hotel company for $327 million.
newsitem.headline: Starwood acquires hotel company for $327 million.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Corp., a major hotel real estate investment trust, said Friday it has a definitive agreement to acquire HEI Hotels LLC for $327 million.

HEI, a closely held company based in Westport, Conn., manages 18 hotels, as well as 10 hotel properties it owns in a joint venture with PRISA II, an institutional real estate investment fund managed by Prudential Real Estate Investors.
Starwood will offer its paired shares and limited partnership interests in Starwood partnerships, as well as $112 million in cash and debt assumed.
HEI will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Starwood.
Starwood, based in Phoenix, said the deal would boost its earnings in the first year of operations. The deal is expected to close by the end of January.
Starwood's stock edged up 37.5 cents to $59 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
